description: This file defines the GenericServiceJob class, which represents an asynchronous service job in the OFBiz framework. It manages service invocation, state transitions, and error handling.

classes.name: GenericServiceJob
classes.description: Represents a generic asynchronous service job that manages execution, state, and error handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getDctx
methods.description: Returns the DispatchContext associated with this job.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the service job, invoking the service synchronously and handling success or failure.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the job before execution, primarily for logging.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks the job as finished successfully.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles failure, logs errors, and updates job state.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the context map for the service invocation.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to invoke.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the job is in a valid state for execution.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Prevents dequeuing of the job, throws exception if attempted.
